package repository

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

// TeacherResponseGenerator is the provider-neutral AI Prompt boundary.
type TeacherResponseGenerator interface {
	Generate(ctx context.Context, input domain.TeacherGenerationRequest) (domain.TeacherGeneratedResponse, error)
	Replay(ctx context.Context, idempotencyKey string) (domain.TeacherGeneratedResponse, error)
}
